# Keyboard

Every canvas shortcut uses `⌘`. An agent's terminal uses every plain key (`Tab` completes,
`Esc` interrupts), so a plain keystroke always goes to the terminal.

`⌘/` shows this list in the app, and **Settings → Keyboard** shows it too.

## The ones to learn first

| Keys | What it does |
|---|---|
| `⌘N` | Start a new task |
| `⌘K` | Find or run anything |
| `⌘J` | Go to the next agent that needs you |
| `⌘Y` | Allow the pending request |
| `⌘⇧S` | Open Sessions |
| `⌘1` `⌘2` `⌘3` | Work, Plan and Map zoom levels |

## Keys that stay with the agent

`Ctrl+C`, `Ctrl+Z` and `Ctrl+B` are never taken by the app. `Ctrl+C` reaches the agent as an
interrupt, as it does in Terminal.

To get out of a terminal with the keyboard, press `⌘Esc`. From there, `Tab` moves through the
app's own controls.

If `⌘K` clears the terminal and does not open the palette, focus lock is on for that panel.
`⌘⇧L` turns it off.
